system_name: Client Organization AI-Native Product Development Harness

stages.name: Acquire Evidence & Build Digital Product Model
stages.description: 78-parameter registry, literature graph, provenance hashes, data dictionary

stages.name: Build AI Design Space & Feasible Bounds
stages.description: Parametric candidate space across moisture, thermal, conditioning, and drying windows

stages.name: Computationally Eliminate Bad Candidates
stages.description: 5-layer filtering: hard constraints, transport bounds, predictive soft, economics, robustness

stages.name: Run Virtual Scenarios & Pareto Multi-Objective Optimization
stages.description: Offline PyTorch GPU inverse solver, sensitivity, trade-off front (cook time vs yield vs lysine)

stages.name: Select Most Informative Experiments (Bayesian OED)
stages.description: Expected information gain, hypothesis discrimination (H1-H5), sample allocation

stages.name: Prototype Validation & Model Feedback Update
stages.description: Closed-loop feedback engine updating digital twin posterior parameters from observations

stages.name: Scale-Up Unit Operations Digital Simulation
stages.description: Mass/energy balances, heat transfer, drying uniformity, 50 T/hr continuous belt modeling

stages.name: Targeted Pilot Validation & Process Records
stages.description: 25-100 kg pilot trials, time/temp/pressure logging, model discrepancy analysis

stages.name: Regulatory, FSSAI & Food-Safety Validation
stages.description: FSSAI standards, microbiological hazards, additive permissibility, allergen/labeling checklist

stages.name: Manufacturing & Techno-Economic Architecture
stages.description: PFD, P&ID, equipment sizing, OPEX/CAPEX breakdown, net advantage per tonne model

stages.name: Factory Qualification & Commercial Validation
stages.description: Production line qualification, changeover protocols, yield verification at scale

stages.name: Launch & Continuous Optimization (Operational Twin)
stages.description: Incoming lot prediction, drift detection, continuous model updates from factory telemetry

gates.name: Product Definition
gates.criterion: Clear dry split dal format, baseline whistle reference logged

gates.name: Evidence Readiness
gates.criterion: Provenance hashes verified; empirical analysis gated awaiting lab results

gates.name: Design Space Feasibility
gates.criterion: FSSAI hard constraints, physical boundaries and screening active

gates.name: Virtual Shortlist
gates.criterion: Multi-objective Pareto front generated on RTX 4050 GPU

gates.name: Experimental Evidence
gates.criterion: Phase 1 diagnostic protocol ready for laboratory commissioning

gates.name: Validated Pilot
gates.criterion: Pilot trial parameters budgeted separately from Phase 1

gates.name: Manufacturing Release
gates.criterion: Factory qualification criteria and QA release documented

gates.name: Sustained Performance
gates.criterion: Continuous drift-detection and lot-prediction telemetry specified
